scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test

SETUP_SECRET.description: Guards your Worker's setup page. Use a long random value, for example the output of `openssl rand -base64 36`, and keep it: the setup page at `/setup` asks for it.

CLASSES.description: The runner classes your box serves, comma-separated. Each becomes a `runs-on` label. The default, `boxrunner,boxrunner-light`, matches the agent's default configuration.

REPOS.description: Optional. Only these repositories (`owner/name`, comma-separated) of the private ones the App is installed on. Leave empty to serve them all.
